The day of the Arima Kinen. This race is 
said to be the final run for the uniquely 
gifted Oguri Cap.

Mejiro Ryan proudly declared that she 
wouldn't let Oguri Cap steal the spotlight 
in this race.

And finally, Mejiro Ryan. Carrying three 
distinct dreams upon their shoulders— the 
curtain now rises on the Arima Kinen!
